name: openvino
description: OpenVINO™ is an open source toolkit for optimizing and deploying AI inference
one_liner: A toolkit that makes AI models run faster and cheaper on ordinary computers and chips, instead of requiring expensive cloud GPUs.
buyer: A hardware-constrained startup, like a security-camera or in-store analytics company, that wants on-device AI without a recurring cloud GPU bill.
business_use_cases: A security-camera startup runs person and object detection on-device instead of paying for per-camera cloud GPU inference.
A retail analytics company deploys in-store footfall or queue-length AI on cheap in-store PCs rather than renting cloud GPUs.
A systems integrator offers 'AI inference cost-cutting' consulting, converting clients' GPU-hungry models to run on cheaper hardware.

money_ideas.idea: Offer model-optimization consulting billed per project to cut a client's cloud inference bill.
Take a share of the client's ongoing cloud savings as a recurring fee.

steal_this: Optimize one well-known open model to run on a $500 mini-PC and pitch it to a local retailer as 'AI camera, no monthly cloud bill.'
